recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping cron on edna and adding two mechanisms now: start/success curl pings to an external dead-man's-switch service such as Healthchecks.io, and a wrapper so the job always emails on exception, with the Synology optionally used only for archiving logs.
note: The reply rejects the Synology/Docker central log but still recommends two alerting mechanisms (external heartbeat plus always-email on failure), and it has none of the four labelled record lines.
